CONT-07 — Major incidents have a post-incident review: Every major incident is reviewed after resolution: root cause, corrective actions and a named signatory. Expected evidence: Incident reference; Root cause; Corrective actions; Review date; Signatory name.
CONT-08 — Incident response times measured against targets: Response times are measured monthly against the committed targets and breaches are counted. Expected evidence: Reporting period; Target response time; Measured response time; Breach count.
CONT-09 — Security incidents notified to the customer: Security incidents affecting a customer are notified through the agreed channel within the agreed delay. Expected evidence: Incident reference; Customer notified date; Notification channel; Notification owner.
CONT-10 — Recurring incidents analysed as problems: Recurring incidents are grouped into problem records with a root cause and a permanent fix. Expected evidence: Problem record; Recurrence evidence; Root cause; Permanent fix.
CONT-11 — Changes approved before implementation: Every production change is approved by a named approver before it is implemented. Expected evidence: Change reference; Approval date; Approver name; Implementation date.
CONT-12 — Emergency changes reviewed afterwards: Emergency changes are justified when raised and reviewed by a second person after implementation. Expected evidence: Emergency change reference; Justification; Post-implementation review date; Reviewer name.
CONT-13 — Change success measured: The share of successful changes and the number of rollbacks are measured every quarter. Expected evidence: Reporting period; Change count; Failed change count; Rollback count.

CONT-27 — Service reviews held with each customer: Each customer has a service review every quarter with minutes and agreed actions. Expected evidence: Customer name; Review date; Attendees; Agreed actions.

CONT-29 — Customer complaints handled within the agreed delay: Customer complaints are recorded and resolved within the agreed delay by a named owner. Expected evidence: Complaint reference; Receipt date; Resolution date; Resolution owner.
CONT-30 — Customer data handling agreement on file: Every customer has a signed data handling agreement that is reviewed once a year. Expected evidence: Customer name; Agreement reference; Signature date; Review date.
